_meta.description: Hand/AI-maintained quality signals for final-arc maps. Read by ada_encyclopedia /api/final-lap. Scores are 0-5 or null=unknown.
_meta.updated: 2026-04-19 (phase 2c — helper-layer lift on 4 under-developed maps: Russell, Gödel, Rhizome, Lab. Under-developed count: 4 → 2. Russell + Gödel cleared (T=3→4). Rhizome + Lab remain flagged — well-scaffolded now but still only 1 artifact each at T=3; honest signal that they'd benefit from a second artifact or a content pass.)

rubric.thesis: Does blurb + intent + artifacts land the sequence's truth statement? 0=off, 5=lands
rubric.helper: Hub present? Close-body text? Readable cues? 0=bare grid, 5=full
rubric.aesthetic: Substrate/biome applied and appropriate to sequence stage? 0=grey, 5=full

CriticalAlgorithms_Algorithmic_Bias_Visu.note: Book, tutorial and technical grounded in bias_from_inside. Next test: Compare a named pair at three slider positions from the same viewing distance, then ask whether the labels remain distinguishable from the intended approach. Record the pair and viewpoint before generalising this to other dense displays.

CriticalAlgorithms_Applied_Ethics.note: Book, tutorial and technical grounded in room_shape_demonstrator. Next test: Build a comparison with equal chair count, scale and colour, changing only the arrangement. Test sightlines and approach routes before claiming the circle is more accessible. Keep the present pair as the openly persuasive first example.

SpeculativeComputation_Paraconsistent_En.note: Book, tutorial and technical grounded in merge_conflict_visualizer. Next test: Add a small inspectable inference table with a contradictory pair and an unrelated proposition. Require the visitor to predict which consequences follow. Compare that with preserving two source-tagged reports, so storage and inference remain distinct lessons.

SpeculativeComputation_Situated_Computat.note: Book, tutorial and technical grounded in situated_readout. Next test: Give each panel an inspectable criterion and the evidence used. Compare disagreement caused by different criteria with disagreement caused by different observations. First verify that all four small panels can be read without losing their footers.

SpeculativeComputation_Collective_Knowle.note: Book, tutorial and technical grounded in peer_production_tool. Next test: Separate lifetime edits, distinct sources in this version, and lifetime distinct sources in the readout. Check two complete cycles with a repeated source. Then add one disputed contribution whose revision changes an existing facet rather than increasing the pile.

SpeculativeComputation_Rhizome_Network.note: Book, tutorial and technical grounded in rhizome_grower. Next test: Expose a selectable node and removal operation, then show connected components before and after deletion. Compare nearest-only growth with one distant connection per shoot. The current exhibit has neither deletion nor automatic repair.

AdvancedLaboratory_Lab_Equipment_Simulat.note: Book, tutorial and technical grounded in MolecularDesigner. Next test: Expose one editable target with a visible link to its source assembly. Compare the same docking motion at two fixed update rates before changing damping. Let a visitor alter one relation and keep the resulting body beside the original.

PostCrisis_Synthesis.note: Book, tutorial and technical grounded in accountability_ledger. Next test: Make the ledger accept a real museum observation with hall, affected activity, proposed change and later result. Preserve unresolved entries across visits. Begin with the contributor-counter ambiguity or a control whose reach has actually been tested.
